ai.how.install.title: Install
ai.how.install.body: Open the download. It sets 6529 AI up to run in the background.
ai.how.model.title: Pick a model
ai.how.model.body: 6529 AI shows the open-weights models that fit this computer, and fetches the one you pick.
ai.how.chat.title: Chat
ai.how.chat.body: Chat in your browser. Everything runs on this computer; the 6529 AI network comes later, with the chain integration.

ai.guide.tryFirst.title: Try first
ai.guide.validator.title: Running a 6529 validator too?
ai.guide.validator.body: Use a separate computer if you can. On one computer, an attacker who exploits a flaw in a model's engine can reach the validator's keys, and a busy model can slow its votes. If you run both, say so when the installer asks: 6529 AI then runs below normal priority.
ai.guide.api.title: Other programs
ai.guide.api.body: Programs on this computer can use your models through the OpenAI-compatible API at {path}, with an app key from {keys}.
ai.knownIssues.title: What nobody has tried yet
ai.knownIssues.lead: Release candidate 1 ran on a few computers before release. These are the gaps, with a workaround where there is one.
